    No. 3 seed Illinois defeated No. 2 seed Houston 65-55 in the 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 on March 26, 2026, advancing to the Elite Eight. Led by David Mirkovic’s 14 points and 10 rebounds, the Fighting Illini used a 17-0 second-half run to overcome the Cougars in Houston. 
    This video explains why Houston player Emanuel Sharp was unable to touch the ball on a specific play:
    00:26
    CW39 Houston
    YouTube• Apr 8, 2025
    Key Details from the Game: 
    • Result: Illinois 65, Houston 55.
    • Decisive Run: Illinois turned a 27-26 lead into a 44-26 advantage with a 17-0 run early in the second half.
    • Top Performers (Illinois): David Mirkovic (14 pts, 10 reb), Keaton Wagler (13 pts), Andrej Stojakovic (13 pts).
    • Top Performers (Houston): Houston was held to 34.4% shooting from the field.
    • Next Up: Illinois advances to face No. 9 seed Iowa in the Elite Eight on Saturday in Houston. 
    Illinois dominated defensively, holding the Cougars to their lowest-scoring game of the season and, at one point, over six minutes without a point in the second half.
